lines.targetText: We need to talk about the water records.

lines.arabicTranslation: نحتاج إلى الحديث عن the water records.
lines.pronunciation: We need to talk about the water records.

lines.targetText: In my opinion, the records are more useful than guesses.
lines.englishReference: In my opinion, the records are more useful than guesses.
lines.arabicTranslation: في رأيي، the records are more useful than guesses.
lines.pronunciation: In my opinion, the records are more useful than guesses.

lines.targetText: Because they show what actually happened.
lines.englishReference: Because they show what actually happened.
lines.arabicTranslation: لأن they show what actually happened.
lines.pronunciation: Because they show what actually happened.

lines.targetText: I suggest that we should check them together.

lines.arabicTranslation: أقترح أن we should check them together.
lines.pronunciation: I suggest that we should check them together.

lines.targetText: Thank you. I will explain it to the team.
lines.englishReference: Thank you. I will explain it to the team.
lines.pronunciation: Thank you. I will explain it to the team.
